summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the poll results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 19, 2026. All 22 ordinary resolutions were carried, including re-election of directors and approval of remuneration reports, while a shareholder resolution (Resolution 23) was not carried with only 13.01% support. This is a routine disclosure of AGM results, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is disclosed.
